label: POST-HOC DIAGNOSTIC, triggered by EXP-052's locked code-robustness rule
not_predeclared: The locked plan said a ranking change under one code and not the others is reported as code-dependent. It fired. This addendum asks WHY it fired, which the plan did not specify and which is therefore post-hoc.
finding: flat32 has charged more to match a relation than to insert one since EXP-034 added the weight channel. Its best mapping matches zero edges on every corpus pair, so its disagreement with gamma and delta is not evidence about the retrieval claim.
residual_weakness: The two surviving codes are both Elias codes. The project's code-robustness argument now rests on two members of one family, which is weaker than it has been presented as. Logged as Q-43 rather than repaired here, because inventing a third code now, knowing what it needs to show, is the move the protocol exists to prevent.
